title: EODC Federation Extension
description: Federated-provider attribution and 1:1 metadata-harmonization provenance for the EODC federated STAC catalogue. The federation is search-time only: collections are not merged, so each harmonized object maps to exactly one source.
$comment: Reference from stac_extensions. Fields: `federation:backends` and `federation:source_*` live in Collection `summaries` / Item `properties`; `federation:provenance` is Collection top-level.

^federation:source_.title: Pre-harmonization value
^federation:source_.description: The original value(s) before vocabulary normalization, kept so a change can be audited/reverted.

backends.title: Federated providers
backends.description: Names of the EODAG providers that can serve this object. Order is not significant.

provenance.title: Harmonization provenance
provenance.description: 1:1 backtracking record: where the object came from and what the harmonization layer changed.

profile_version.description: Version of the harmonization rules that produced this object.

target_stac_version.description: STAC version this object was migrated to.

software.title: Harmonization software
software.description: The software/agent that performed the harmonization (W3C PROV 'Agent').

source.title: Source
source.description: The single source this object corresponds to. 'upstream-collection' = a pass-through with a known source document; 'provider-product' = a locally federated collection, identified by provider(s).

href.description: Source collection URL, when one exists (kind=upstream-collection).

retrieved_at.description: When the source metadata was fetched (startup time for pass-throughs).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source metadata snapshot, for reproducibility.

transformations.title: Transformations
transformations.description: Ordered list of field-level operations applied by the harmonization layer.

target.description: Path of the changed field, e.g. 'summaries/constellation', 'stac_version', 'cube:dimensions/time/extent'.

operation.description: Operation id. See the operation reference in the README (e.g. 'vocabulary:constellation', 'migration:stac_version', 'bands:migrate', 'extension:drop_unused', 'datacube:fix_temporal_extent').

source.description: Original value before harmonization (any JSON type).

value.description: New (canonical) value after harmonization (any JSON type).

issue.description: Upstream defect id this workaround addresses, e.g. 'UP-1' (see the catalogue's UPSTREAM_ISSUES.md).
